text: (1) Applicants for master's degree programs must have a bachelor's degree and a HSK level 5 score of 180 or above. Applicants for doctoral programs must have a master's degree and a HSK level 5 score of 180 or above, with excellent academic performance and good physical and mental health.(2) To study in an English-taught program, the following conditions must be met: 1) English is the native language or the official language; 2) IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80; 3) The language of instruction in university courses is English; 4) An English proficiency level recognized by Zhejiang University of Technology.
